name: Knees Over Toes (Public Scaffold)
description: Ground-up knee resilience work: backward locomotion, then lower legs, then step-ups, then split squat, then deep squat, with upper-body and posterior-chain accessories at the end. Two phases: Zero (bodyweight, no equipment, 3x/week) and Dense (loaded, sled/slant board/tib bar or their substitutions). Standards are expressed as a percentage of bodyweight.
attribution: Structure and standards are the publicly described Knees Over Toes / ATG scaffold. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or licensed from ATG. Replace with Seth's own program data when available.

zero.name: Zero
zero.note: Bodyweight, no equipment, 3x/week. The entry phase — every step here is doable at home with a wall, a low step and a floor.

dense.name: Dense
dense.note: Loaded phase. Adds sled (or its substitute), Poliquin step, Nordic progressions, reverse Nordic, seated good morning, Jefferson curl on a slant board, and the ATG RDL. Each Dense step lists the Zero step it unlocks from.

blocks.name: Backward Locomotion
blocks.note: Always first. Backward walking or sled work — 'reverse out knee pain'. No sled at Home or Planet Fitness: substitute a powered-off treadmill or backward walking outdoors.

blocks.name: Lower Legs
blocks.note: Tibialis and calves before anything loads the knee from above.

blocks.name: Step-Ups
blocks.note: Patrick step then Poliquin step. Knee travels forward over the toes under control.

blocks.name: Split Squat
blocks.note: ATG split squat assisted, then flat, then loaded. Plus the hip and quad length work (elephant walk, couch stretch) that makes full range possible.

blocks.name: Deep Squat
blocks.note: Full-depth squat holds and loaded ATG squats, plus the L-sit.

blocks.name: Upper Body & Posterior-Chain Accessory
blocks.note: Performed after the ground-up lower-body sequence: hamstring/low-back work (Nordic, reverse Nordic, ATG RDL, seated good morning, Jefferson curl, QL extension) and the upper-body standards (incline DB press, external rotation, cross-bench pullover).

steps.name: Backward Walking (Zero)
steps.standard_text: 10 minutes of continuous backward walking, 3x/week.

substitutions.note: Planet Fitness or bad weather: walk backwards on a POWERED-OFF treadmill, driving the belt yourself.

steps.name: Backward Sled Drag (Dense)
steps.standard_text: Backward sled drag at roughly 50% bodyweight, 10 minutes of accumulated work.

substitutions.note: Planet Fitness has no sled: backward walking on a powered-off treadmill is the substitute (RESEARCH §2, §7).
Home: backward walking outdoors, in a hallway, or up a gentle incline.

steps.name: Tibialis Raise (Zero)
steps.standard_text: 25 unbroken bodyweight tibialis raises against a wall.

steps.name: Tib Bar Raise (Dense)
steps.standard_text: Tib bar curl at 25% bodyweight for 5 sets of 5.

substitutions.note: No tib bar at Home or Planet Fitness: stand a dumbbell on end and pinch it between the feet.
Band looped over the forefoot and anchored low in front — the travel version.

steps.name: FHL Calf Raise (Zero)
steps.standard_text: 3 sets of 25 bodyweight calf raises pressing through the big toe (flexor hallucis longus emphasis).

steps.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise (Zero)
steps.standard_text: 3 sets of 10 bodyweight single-leg calf raises per side, full stretch at the bottom.

steps.name: Loaded Single-Leg Calf Raise (Dense)
steps.standard_text: 25% bodyweight held in one hand, 10 reps per leg, off a step or slant board.

substitutions.note: No slant board: use a stair edge, a plate stack, or a DIY plywood wedge for the heel drop.

steps.name: Patrick Step (Zero)
steps.standard_text: 3 sets of 10 per side off a 2–4 inch step, free leg locked straight, heel taps the floor.

substitutions.note: Any stable 2–4 inch rise: a stair, a stack of plates, a low bench.

steps.name: Poliquin Step-Up (Dense)
steps.standard_text: 66% bodyweight (total load) for 20 reps on a 3–4 inch box, heel elevated.

substitutions.note: No slant board for the heel wedge: stack two plates or use a DIY plywood wedge.
No 3–4 inch box: regress to the Patrick step off a stair until a box is available.

steps.name: ATG Split Squat — Assisted (Zero)
steps.standard_text: 3 sets of 10 per side holding a rail or band for assistance; hamstring covers the calf at the bottom.

steps.name: ATG Split Squat — Flat (Zero)
steps.standard_text: 3 sets of 10 per side, bodyweight, no hands, full range on flat ground.

steps.name: ATG Split Squat — Loaded (Dense)
steps.standard_text: 25% of bodyweight PER HAND (dumbbells) through full range, each side.

substitutions.note: Bodyweight or a weight vest / loaded backpack at home until dumbbells are heavy enough.

steps.name: Elephant Walk (Zero)
steps.standard_text: 20 alternating reps with the hands on the floor and the knee locked on the pressing side.

steps.name: Couch Stretch (Zero)
steps.standard_text: 90 seconds per side with the pelvis tucked and the glute squeezed.

steps.name: Deep Squat Hold (Zero)
steps.standard_text: 3 holds of 60 seconds at full depth with the heels flat.

substitutions.note: Heels lifting: elevate them on a DIY wedge or stacked plates until ankle range allows flat feet.

steps.name: ATG Squat (Dense)
steps.standard_text: 25% of bodyweight for 20 reps at full depth.

steps.name: L-Sit (Zero)
steps.standard_text: 3 holds of 20 seconds with the knees locked and the heels off the floor.

steps.name: ATG RDL (Dense)
steps.standard_text: 100% of bodyweight for 10 reps, or 50% of bodyweight for 20 reps.

substitutions.note: No barbell at Planet Fitness (floor deadlifts are also not permitted): use dumbbells, a fixed bar, or the Smith machine.

steps.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl (Dense)
steps.standard_text: Full bodyweight Nordic curl for 10 reps, lowering under control.

substitutions.note: Home: use the adjustable bench with the Nordic support (ankles anchored under the pad/roller).
Planet Fitness has no GHD and nothing safe to anchor under: run the ATG RDL instead that day.

steps.name: Reverse Nordic Curl (Dense)
steps.standard_text: 3 sets of 8–10 through the fullest controllable range, hips locked straight.

steps.name: Seated Good Morning (Dense)
steps.standard_text: 50% of bodyweight across the upper back, seated, with the arch held.

substitutions.note: No Smith or fixed bar: hold a single heavy dumbbell at the chest and hinge from the hips.

steps.name: Jefferson Curl (Dense)
steps.standard_text: 25% of bodyweight for 10 reps, rolling down until the wrists are below the toes.

substitutions.note: No slant board: stand on a DIY wedge, stacked plates, or the end of a flat bench so the wrists can pass below the toes.

steps.name: QL Extension (Dense)
steps.standard_text: 25% of bodyweight for 10 reps, segmental flexion and extension under control.

substitutions.note: No back-extension bench: the seated good morning covers the same low-back standard.

steps.name: Incline Dumbbell Press (Dense)
steps.standard_text: 66% of bodyweight (total, both dumbbells) for 10 reps on an incline bench.

substitutions.note: No adjustable bench: use the Smith machine incline or a chest-press machine set high.

steps.name: Shoulder External Rotation (Dense)
steps.standard_text: 10% of bodyweight for controlled external rotation reps, each side.

substitutions.note: Band or cable external rotation is equivalent for this standard.

steps.name: Cross-Bench Pullover (Dense)
steps.standard_text: 25% of bodyweight, performed lying ACROSS the bench (hips low) for a full stretch overhead.

substitutions.note: No bench: lie on the floor and accept the reduced range, or use a stability ball.
